question:
The following graph shows the production of arm chairs by three companies X, Y and Z, over 6 years.. Based on the graph answer the question given below. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53b4e2d5ef27de563efc30b090dd9f2f410762405c27967731d56e0cd701a373.png] 

What is the percentage decrease in the production of arm chairs by company Z from 2013 to 2017?
solution:
**Given:**

Production of armchairs by Company Z in 2013 = 50 lakhs

Production of armchairs by Company Z in 2017 = 30 lakhs

**Formula used:**

Percentage decrease = ((Initial value - Final value) / Initial value) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Percentage decrease = ((50 - 30) / 50) × 100

⇒ Percentage decrease = (20 / 50) × 100

⇒ Percentage decrease ≈ 40%

**∴ The percentage decrease in the production of armchairs by Company Z from 2013 to 2017 is 40%.**
